newsitem.title: URUGUAY: Uruguay 1996 trade deficit rises to $925 mln.
newsitem.headline: Uruguay 1996 trade deficit rises to $925 mln.

text.p: Uruguay posted a $925.6 million trade deficit in 1996, up from a $760.9 million shortfall in 1995, the central bank said Wednesday.
Imports rose $3.32 billion in 1996 from $2.87 billion a year earlier. Exports climbed to $2.39 billion from $2.10 billion in 1995.
The bank said Uruguay's December trade deficit was $96.7 million, up from $88.9 million in the same month of the previous year but lower than the $113.4 million gap in November 1996.
